title: Conservation of Momentum and the Kinetic Energy Conservation
text: By conservation of kinetic energy and of momentum, $$\tfrac12m_{1}v_{1}**2=\tfrac12m_{1}v_{1}'**2+\tfrac12m_{2}v_{2}'**2,$$ $$m_{1}v_{1}=m_{1}v_{1}'\cos\theta_{1}'+m_{2}v_{2}'\cos\theta_{2}',$$ and $$0=m_{1}v_{1}'\sin\theta_{1}'-m_{2}v_{2}'\sin\theta_{2}'.$$ Plug in the values and solve this system of equations for $$v_{1}',$$ $$v_{2}',$$ and $$\theta_{2}'$$.
